correctness.rationale: The geometric formulas yield X=Σλ_i U_i² and Y=DΣλ_i^-1 U_i². Squared spherical coordinates have exact Dirichlet(1/2,1/2,1/2) density; their affine map to (X,Y) has nonzero Vandermonde Jacobian, proving a normalized complete joint law and eight sign preimages. Exact uniform-sphere fourth moments yield Cov(X,Y)=-(2D/45)Σ_{i<j}(λ_i-λ_j)²/(λ_iλ_j)<0. Repeated axes reduce to beta line or point. Three Monte Carlo spectra and exact SymPy identities checked independently of proof.

value.rationale: A complete and motivated geometric-tomography two-measurement law is obtained, including all direction fibers, exact full shape recovery from support, boundary density singularities and a rank-3/2/1 multiplicity classification. These are joint and inverse properties unavailable from prior one-dimensional measurements, and the strict covariance quantifies the naturally paired geometric measurements. Unlike a random parameter slice, the observables are canonical width and projected area of the same view.
